accessibility.text: Are the target objects touching each other?
🎯 Goal: determine weather the model can understand if the target objects are in contact or not
# samples per model: 5 correct & 5 incorrect proposals per template (500 total)
Only the 4 best performing VLMs proceed in the evaluation
